#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Cobalt

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Cobalt resources:
#   -q full-node
#   -n 1
#   -t 240   (minutes)
#   -A datascience
#   --attrs filesystems=home,grand,eagle,theta-fs0

# Allocate one node; request 8 MPI ranks (as implied by RANKS_PER_NODE=8)
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 8
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=240m

# Omitted Cobalt option: -q full-node (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may not get full-node access or may be scheduled under different limits/priority.

# Omitted Cobalt option: -A datascience (project/account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted Cobalt option: --attrs filesystems=home,grand,eagle,theta-fs0
# Flux does not have a universal portable equivalent for these job attributes.
# Performance implication: required filesystems may not be mounted/available, causing I/O failures or degraded performance.

# Necessary for Bash shells
. /etc/profile

# Tensorflow/PyTorch environment
module load conda/pytorch

# Activate conda env
conda activate pycords
export PYTHONPATH=/lus/grand/projects/datascience/ianwixom/expcifar:$PYTHONPATH

module list

# Cobalt used mpirun with -N and $COBALT_NODEFILE. Under Flux, use flux-run.
# Performance implication: if your MPI stack requires a particular mpirun configuration, site-specific settings may be needed.
flux run -n 8 -c 1 \
  --env=LD_LIBRARY_PATH \
  --env=PYTHONPATH \
  --env=PATH \
  python cifar10cordsmodel.py

reasons: Cobalt requested the `full-node` queue, which implies exclusive/full-node allocation, but the Flux resource section does not request exclusivity or the full node; this can lead to shared-node placement and contention.

Cobalt used 1 node (`-n 1`), but the script's internal intent (8 ranks per node) is encoded only by setting `-n 8` tasks; without also requesting/encoding full-node CPU resources, the allocation may not match the intended per-node capacity.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT -n 1
#COBALT -t 240
#COBALT -A datascience
#COBALT --attrs filesystems=home,grand,eagle,theta-fs0
# Necessary for Bash shells
. /etc/profile

# Tensorflow optimized for A100 with CUDA 11
module load conda/pytorch
# module load conda/pytorch

# Activate conda env
conda activate pycords
# conda activate base
export PYTHONPATH=/lus/grand/projects/datascience/ianwixom/expcifar:$PYTHONPATH

# User Configuration
# INIT_SCRIPT=$PWD/activate-dh.sh
COBALT_JOBSIZE=1
RANKS_PER_NODE=8

# Initialization of environment
# source $INIT_SCRIPT
module list
mpirun -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x PYTHONPATH -x PATH -n $(( $COBALT_JOBSIZE * $RANKS_PER_NODE )) -N $RANKS_PER_NODE --hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE python cifar10cordsmodel.py
